## Why visit

A particularly good match for travellers who care about what is in the cellar. The small family-run pub sources directly from microbreweries, displays forthcoming beers and tries to keep a dark option available. Its quiet, games-friendly setting makes it a natural place to talk through discoveries rather than stand in a noisy tasting hall. Together with Volunteer Canteen, it gives Waterloo enough variety to justify a focused half-day. Cider is an additional reason to include it on a trip weighted towards traditional drinks.
